binding_interval_registry.rule: An interval becomes permanently opened when any market-derived output from it is observed. Source or parameter changes can never restore its validation eligibility.

requirements: Run one contiguous account timeline; do not restart NAV, detector state or portfolio state every seven days.
Define the claimed scenario domain before evaluation: direction, session, volatility state and cross-market role.
Aggregate trades sharing one UTC date, session, direction and common displacement into one economic cluster.
Require positive after-cost cluster log expectancy under leave-one-cluster-out deletion.
Require no single cluster to contribute more than 25% of positive log growth.
Require at least 20 independent economic clusters spanning at least three non-overlapping 28-day blocks before spending fresh data.
If the strategy claims both directions or multiple scenarios, each claimed domain must independently contain positive after-cost evidence; otherwise narrow the claim before source freeze.

fresh_validation.execution: Run each block exactly once through NautilusTrader with one continuous NAV/state timeline and the global one-slot contract.
fresh_validation.first_block_failure: Reject the frozen candidate. The block becomes opened development data. Any repair is a new candidate and requires a new untouched block.
fresh_validation.first_block_pass: Run the second block with byte-identical strategy and config.
minimum_evidence: At least 12 independent economic clusters per 28-day block; fewer is a frequency failure, not permission to extend or choose another block after seeing results.
Positive after-cost NAV log growth in each block.
Pooled after-cost daily geometric NAV growth at least 1% across the precommitted 56 calendar days.
All project safety, risk-budget, cost, causality and global-slot audits pass.
No scenario/domain may be silently removed after seeing the first block.
fresh_validation.resolution_tail: The source freeze must define a finite maximum holding period. After each 28-day decision window, disable new entries and provide a data tail at least as long as that maximum holding period so existing orders and positions resolve through the frozen target, stop or time exit. A block-end forced mark exit is not a win/loss observation.
fresh_validation.selection: Select two non-overlapping contiguous 28-day blocks from different calendar quarters using a committed deterministic seed and an exclusion registry of every opened date plus warmup.
fresh_validation.source_freeze: Commit exact strategy, config, data adapter, cost model and audit code before selecting or downloading the interval.
fresh_validation.success_claim: Allowed only when both untouched blocks pass without any source/config change.

long_evaluation.boundary_rule: Use the same no-new-entry resolution tail at the final boundary; do not turn an unresolved position into an arbitrary period-end result.
long_evaluation.failure_interpretation: A failure is a logic/generalization failure unless evidence audit identifies a concrete implementation defect.
long_evaluation.method: Run the same frozen source on a long contiguous interval. Report rolling 7/28-day growth, independent-cluster expectancy, domain coverage and regime transitions; do not reset weekly.

purpose: Prevent isolated random-week winner's curse, adaptive holdout reuse, latent-regime duplication and weekly-state reset from being mistaken for durable alpha.
